The derived package contains AArch64 hard_npu.ko, soft_npu.ko, and cma_mem.ko whose embedded vermagic text is 6.1.111-rt42 SMP preempt mod_unload aarch64.

The same derived package's driver Makefiles default to Linux 5.10.142 and an aarch64-anlogic-11.3 toolchain, while the build script references an unprovided /home/uisrc/uisrc-lab-anlogic kernel/toolchain.
The derived package contains AArch64 Arm NN/ONNX parser libraries and a camera/HDMI demo ELF, not the standalone APUG npu_runtime package identity.
No rt.bin, weight.bin, convert_tool, or al_ai_flow was found in the bounded direct NPU_info or searched package paths.
The official dr1m90_npu source mirror is SDK_2026.01, while the knowledge version matrix records the local SDK baseline as SDK_2025_07; exact component alignment is not established.

The Arm NN demo path is statically buildable in an isolated VM workspace and is distinct from the APUG npu_runtime/rt.bin/weight.bin path; both paths still share the kernel-driver, CMA, Device Tree and FPGA hardware substrate.

The SDK kernel source and Linaro toolchain can produce AArch64 driver objects and the Arm NN demo can link, but missing Module.symvers and unresolved-symbol warnings prevent treating those outputs as loadable or deployment-ready.
